corrections.old_text: እለ ፡ ምሉआን ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ወጥበበ ፡ እለ ፡
corrections.corrected_text: እለ ፡ ምሉአን ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ ቅዱሰ ፡ ወጥበበ ፡ እለ ፡
corrections.reason: Stage 1 hallucinated a non-Ethiopic Devanagari character 'आ' in place of the clearly printed Fidel 'አ' in the Ge'ez plural adjective 'ምሉአን' (Acts 6:3).
The printed Ethiopic numeral after '፲፪ ፥' is clearly '፯' (7), not '፳' (20).
